span.p:
CONCEPTUAL ONLY.
Leak size = overlap of other eye's primary SPD with this filter's stop band,
weighted by photopic V(lambda) (Woods and Rourke 2004).
Measured crosstalk per eye = (ghost - black) / (white - black).
Real leak values: see plots/C1-C4 (LEE published data) and future measurements.

svg.text: B. CONCEPTUAL optical separation (red/cyan example; same logic for magenta/green and amber/blue). Not to scale, no measured values.
